title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Growth
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven, and accomplished Senior Account Executive, Strategic Growth focused on executing an enterprise growth strategy in your designated APAC region in partnership with a global sales team devoted to our largest global client relationships in the Financial Services market. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth company and sell an award-winning product that is rapidly getting adopted across the market internationally, and this person will be able to make a significant contribution to the company’s growth and future success.

• Strong Consultative Selling skills. Ability to listen actively, ask insightful questions, and uncover the real needs of the client, becoming a trusted partner. Use your knowledge of the industry, competitive environment, and client experiences to identify trends and stay ahead of customer needs.

• Partner with the global sales team to build and execute a strategic client growth plan for your designated APAC region. You own the sales plan for your region in partnership with the Strategic Account Executives in the other global regions, driving deals forward and delivering on a shared revenue target.

• Deploy a long term account strategy, with short and medium term execution plans, layering a transactional sales motion with an enterprise mindset and focus. Able to cold call and prospect across a client base while building a pipeline, from identifying the right opportunities to gaining access to the right levels of and across an organization; influencing and building advocacy to create the conditions for enterprise sales.

• Partner with our Global Customer Success, Sales Development and Product Specialist teams to deliver strong growth across a defined client base.

• Conduct product demonstrations in a value-based sales environment.

• An energetic and creative individual, possessing natural curiosity with the ability to learn quickly.

• Strong ability to develop rapport with new people, and to maintain relationships, combined with a positive, outgoing personality.

title: Manager, Sales Strategy and Operations
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role
Nebius is looking for a Sales Strategy and Operations Manager (IC) to partner directly with our sales leadership team to shape and execute Nebius ’ go-to-market strategy and drive operational excellence across the full revenue lifecycle for our selling teams in the Americas market.
You will act as a strategic business partner to Sales leadership and support the execution of the go-to-market strategy through data-driven insights, process optimization, and operational excellence.
This role will own key processes related to quarterly planning cycles, territory alignment, forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and CRM governance. You will ensure operational consistency across the region and provide visibility into performance metrics that drive revenue outcomes.
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional who combines strong analytical skills with structured thinking and execution rigor. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with large datasets, building dashboards, improving sales processes, and collaborating cross-functionally with Finance, Marketing, and GTM stakeholders.
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Support Sales leadership in weekly forecast reviews and pipeline inspections

• Maintain and improve forecast tracking models and reporting structures

• Build and maintain dashboards in CRM / BI tools to monitor bookings, pipeline generation, conversion rates, and attainment

• Ensure CRM data hygiene and enforce standardized pipeline management practices

• Support territory alignment updates and account ownership changes

• Assist in quarterly planning cycles (target tracking, headcount tracking, performance visibility)

• Partner with Finance on revenue visibility and reporting alignment

• Monitor lead routing logic and GTM workflows across HubSpot and Salesforce

• Identify process gaps and propose operational improvements

• Support documentation of GTM processes and internal playbooks

• Assist with system enhancements and new tool rollouts

• Provide ad-hoc analysis to support business decisions
We expect you to have:

• 6-7+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a similar analytical function (preferably in Cloud, SaaS, or other technology)

• Strong hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce and HubSpot)

• Experience working with forecasting processes and pipeline reporting

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; experience working with large datasets

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, scaling environment
Key employee benefits in the US:

•
Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

•
401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

•
Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

title: VP of Revenue Marketing
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Vice President of Demand Generation to build and lead a predictable, scalable growth engine. This leader will own demand creation, pipeline generation, and opportunity acceleration across the customer journey.

The ideal candidate can connect product engagement, marketing signals, and sales outreach to drive efficient customer acquisition and revenue growth. This role will partner closely with Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success. This role will be onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco or New York.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Develop and execute an integrated revenue marketing strategy aligned with the company’s pipeline and revenue goals.

- Lead global demand generation, field marketing, and partner marketing teams.

- Build integrated campaigns across digital, in-person, event, partner, and account-based channels.

- Create sales-led growth and product-led growth programs that convert product usage, buyer intent, and account engagement into qualified opportunities.

- Own marketing-sourced pipeline, opportunity progression, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, and campaign ROI.

- Develop field marketing programs and experiences tailored to priority accounts, industries, and regions.

- Partner with Sales to define target segments, improve lead management, and accelerate opportunities through the funnel.

- Collaborate with Partnerships to build joint campaigns and programs that generate pipeline and expand customer relationships.

- Collaborate with Product and Product Marketing on launches, positioning, adoption, and expansion campaigns.

- Lead paid media, account-based marketing, lifecycle marketing, events, webinars, email, and content syndication.

- Establish clear attribution, forecasting, experimentation, and reporting frameworks.

- Develop annual and quarterly plans for campaigns, budgets, headcount, and performance.

- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing revenue marketing organization.

- Evaluate and optimize the marketing technology stack, agency partnerships, and channel mix.

- Present performance insights, forecasts, and recommendations to the executive team.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years leading revenue or demand generation teams.

- Experience leading demand generation, field marketing, and partner marketing functions in a global B2B organization.

- Proven success building scalable pipeline programs in a high-growth environment.

- Proven ability to create integrated digital and in-person campaigns that generate pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and grow existing accounts.

- Deep understanding of sales-led and product-led growth models, including how to integrate product signals with marketing and sales motions.

- Strong expertise in digital acquisition, account-based marketing, lifecycle marketing, field marketing, and marketing operations.

- Experience managing significant budgets and improving acquisition efficiency.

- Strong command of funnel metrics, attribution, forecasting, and revenue analytics.

- Proven ability to align Marketing, Sales, Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success around shared goals and processes.

- Experience with CRM, HubSpot, marketing automation, intent, attribution, and analytics platforms.

- Strong people leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills.

Location: This role will be onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco or New York.

title: POST-DOCTORAT : Évaluation de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles – CDD 12 mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous
En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée.
Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles.
Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.

Le recrutement d’un ingénieur de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.

· Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes.
· Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés.
· Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge.
Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons
Vous êtes titulaire d’un Doctorat.

Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle.
Et idéalement :
· Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes.
· Junior accepté : Oui
· Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).

Vos atouts supplémentaires :
• Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle.
• Vous possédez une expérience pratique des techniques d’injection de fautes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?
Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :
· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide

title: Director, Financial Systems Engineering
description:
About Extend :

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend 's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:
Extend runs a service-contract business where every dollar must be traceable from inbound merchant data, through our operational and analytics databases, into the accounting system, and back out to obligor, reinsurer, and audit reporting. This role owns the systems and controls that keep that traceability automated, tested, and auditable as the business scales.
We are looking for a Director, Financial Systems Engineering to lead that work. The scope includes the invoicing logic, the financial data models the business reports from, and the automated controls that validate results before they reach an invoice. You’ll report into Engineering leadership, and you’ll lead a team of individual contributors.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own SQL and dbt models in version control, review and approve changes to the logic that produces reported numbers, and answer for the correctness of what comes out. You will also own the cross-functional escalation path across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, Revenue/Go-to-Market, and Accounting when commercial commitments and system behavior need to be reconciled.
You will have wide latitude to shape how financial controls and revenue assurance work at a company growing quickly, including how much of that is handled in code.
What You’ll Do:

•
Own the reconciliation system across contracts sold, merchant invoicing, claims paid, and servicing reimbursements. Build automated tie-outs with alerting between inbound merchant data, operational databases, the analytics warehouse, the accounting system, and external reporting, so that variances surface quickly and are routed to an owner.

•
Own the invoicing logic and the programmatic controls that keep contracted commercial terms accurately reflected in it.

•
Own the financial data models the business reports from, including the logic that recognizes contract revenue as contracts mature and the record of what claims cost us. These live in the shared dbt repository and follow its platform standards for tests, PR review, and change control. You own the business logic in these models and review every change to it.

•
Partner with the merchant integration and Data Engineering teams on merchant configuration. They own ingestion and mapping. You facilitate internal audits of how inbound merchant formats map to internal representations, and work with them to resolve what those audits surface, so that expense and contract attribution holds up downstream.

•
Own the exception and reconciliation-break process , covering triage, resolution ownership, and root-cause tracking with SLAs on detection latency, so that findings inform systemic improvements.

•
Partner with Revenue/Go-to-Market on merchant escalations, including direct merchant engagement on billing questions, and coordinate across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, and Accounting on who needs to do what, when, and why

description:
About the Role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer on the Compute & Storage Platform team in Toast, you will design, build, and operate the foundational distributed systems powering the Toast platform as the company expands into further international markets and broadens its product offerings to encompass retail shopping.

You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and cutting-edge product development-building low-latency state and storage systems, scalable compute clusters, and high-throughput streaming pipelines. Your work will directly enable Toast product delivery across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).

Key Responsibilities

• Online Databases and Storage: Architect, deploy, and manage low-latency, highly available storage solutions (RDS Postgres and Aurora Postgres; DynamoDB; OpenSearch; S3) to power applications across the Toast product ecosystem.

• High Availability & Realtime Performance: Ensure sub-second end-user latency, near-zero-downtime reliability, and high throughput across storage engines to support Toast's products across POS, phone, computer, drive-thru, and kiosk interfaces.

• Infrastructure for AI-Driven PDLC: Automate infrastructure provisioning and compute pipelines.

• Cost Optimization & Performance Engineering: Right-size compute/storage resources, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage AWS infrastructure costs without compromising platform reliability or latency SLAs.

Required Qualifications

1. Core Infrastructure & Automation

• Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

• Software Development: Fluency in Python , Go , or a similar language for infrastructure automation, tooling, or backend development.

2. Storage & Compute Operations

• Databases: Deep experience operating and tuning enterprise databases at scale. This should include at least one variety of relational database (such as Postgres, Oracle, or MySQL) and at least one type of nonrelational database (such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Opensearch).

• Containerization: Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

3. Systems Reliability & Observability

• Solid understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including monitoring, alerting, health checks, and performance troubleshooting in high-traffic environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

• Observability & Telemetry with Datadog, Prometheus

• AI/ML Infrastructure support

• Cloud Cost Optimization

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s commercial products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend microservices, guest- and restaurant-facing web apps, payment systems, event buses, and more. 

The Infrastructure Engineering group manages Toast's infrastructure via the AWS API, using configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, and internally developed clients using Python and Go. We rely heavily on Datadog and Splunk for monitoring and observability and on FireHydrant for alerting and incident response.

Infrastructure Engineering provides the products and services to support, deploy, and monitor our product suite, which uses a microservice architecture written using JVM and Node.js apps. AWS products are also in heavy usage, ranging from S3 to RDS, DynamoDB, ECS, Lambda, and many others. We have our own platform for user management, service discovery/elevations, and load balancing. We use Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data synchronization between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ and Apache Pulsar clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the applications' RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
OUR MISSION

We're not your average benefits platform; we're the unordinary force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology is the link that connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers

Our mission is clear: we're here to create a world where everything operates at its very best, ensuring that every employee receives the support they need to live life to the fullest, both at work and beyond.

YOUR MISSION

Ben has more business-critical bets than it has people who can own one. As our Chief of Staff, you will take the hardest and most ambiguous of them and turn them into shipped outcomes: new propositions, incubation bets, structural changes to how the company runs. When something matters and there's no obvious owner or playbook, it lands with you.

This is not your typical Chief of Staff role - it is a true builder's role. You'll run point on the cross-functional initiatives that decide where Ben goes next, in close partnership with the founders and with a real hand in shaping the company's next chapter. Ultimately, you’ll have huge agency to drive impact across the whole business.

One Honest Note

We won't pretend this is going to be easy. It's an intense role, and there'll be stretches that properly test you. But get it right, and it's the kind of experience that shapes a career - genuinely some of the most exciting, highest-impact work you'll ever do.

THINGS YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

- Own the grey space: take on our most ambiguous, highest-stakes cross-functional projects, the ones with no clear approach, and drive them from a blank page to a delivered result.

- Get our next big bets off the ground: new propositions, incubation, and the strategic projects that don't sit inside any one team's remit. You scope them, you build them, you deliver them.

- You'll own what used to take a team: use Claude, Cursor and similar tools to get through the research, the reporting and the busywork that used to need several people. AI tooling is already a big part of how this team works, and will be essential for this role. The bar is that you're already building with it.

- Win the room: write the narratives that go to the board, the all-hands and the wider company when a project needs buy-in or explaining.

- Build for scale: put in place the light-touch systems and workflows that let 90 people operate like 300, without adding process for its own sake.

YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE/ARE…

- Worked directly with founders: whether that came from strategy, consulting, banking, product, operations, or a Chief of Staff seat before. You know how to give a leadership team real headroom.

- Owned a problem from a blank page through to delivery: with no one else's roadmap to fall back on.

- Real range across strategy and execution: you'll build the model and write the board narrative, then go and do the unglamorous work that makes it happen.

- A background where "no" wasn't the end of it: you've got a plan over the line that other people had written off.

- A first-principles thinker: you work the answer out from scratch. Where you've inherited a playbook, you can tell us what you kept and what you binned.

- Known to follow-through until it's actually done: you chase, you follow up, and you don't let a stalled project quietly die.

- Scaled a fast-growing B2B SaaS business: not essential, but it will put you ahead. You know what breaks at each stage, and what to put in place before it does.

- Experience with one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), plus strong knowledge of operating systems, networking, and identity systems.

- Experience building security automation and tooling, with strong scripting or software engineering skills in Python, Go, or similar languages.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

CAPCO - THE FUTURE. NOW.

Capco is a distinctly and positively different place to work. Much more than consultants, we are passionate business and technology professionals who thrive on innovation, collaboration and making a real impact.

As a global technology and business consultancy, we combine deep industry expertise with innovative thinking to help our clients navigate complex challenges and drive meaningful transformation across Financial Services, Energy & Utilities and beyond.

At Capco, we believe that our people make the difference. We foster a collaborative, inclusive and non-hierarchical environment where your ideas matter, your contributions are recognised, and you are encouraged to take ownership of your career.

Our culture is built around three core values:

•
Be Yourself at Work - Bring your authentic self, your unique perspectives and your ideas.

•
Make a Difference - Challenge convention, embrace innovation and create meaningful impact for our clients and colleagues.

•
Act with Integrity - Build trust through honesty, respect and accountability.

Whether you are looking to deepen your industry expertise, develop new skills or take the next step in your consulting career, Capco offers an environment where you can grow, contribute and succeed.

LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU

Are you an experienced Business Analyst with a passion for the Energy & Utilities sector? Do you enjoy analysing complex business processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and translating business challenges into practical solutions?

At Capco, we are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with Retail Energy expertise to strengthen our consulting team in Belgium.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to business and digital transformation initiatives within the energy industry, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to improve operational processes, enhance customer experiences and support organisations in an evolving energy landscape.

If you combine strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in Retail Energy, excellent stakeholder management skills and a proactive mindset, we would love to meet you.

LET'S GET DOWN TO BUSINESS

As a Business Analyst within our Energy & Utilities practice, you will play a key role in bridging the gap between business needs and technology solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

•
Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify, analyse and document business needs, functional requirements and improvement opportunities.

•
Process Analysis & Optimisation: Analyse existing business processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and contribute to designing improved future-state processes.

•
Functional Documentation: Translate business requirements into functional specifications, business requirement documents (BRDs), process flows, use cases and user stories.

•
Stakeholder Collaboration: Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews and working sessions to ensure alignment between business teams, IT teams and project stakeholders.

•
Solution Design & Validation: Support the implementation and validation of business solutions, ensuring that functional requirements are correctly understood and delivered.

•
Consulting & Project Delivery: Prepare analyses, presentations, reports and recommendations while contributing to project planning, delivery and continuous improvement.

Depending on the project, you may be involved in transformation initiatives covering different aspects of the Retail Energy value chain, including customer management, billing, sales processes and market communication.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a proactive, analytical and collaborative professional who combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on knowledge of the Retail Energy sector.

title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova : the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters . Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it. This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build. Wer wir sind
Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. title: Staff Product Manager, Ads Measurement
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the consumer journey - from inspiration and discovery through consideration, purchase, and long-term customer relationships. Pinners’ commercial intent and engagement create valuable signals that can help advertisers better understand and improve their performance. This role will define how Pinterest applies identity, conversion, and measurement signals to help advertisers identify and acquire new customers, measure incremental outcomes, and optimize campaign bidding. By connecting measurement insights with campaign decisioning, this leader will help advertisers maximize business outcomes and strengthen Pinterest’s differentiation in the ads ecosystem.

 

The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial experience in ads measurement, optimization, or adjacent advertising technology. They deeply understand how advertisers set growth objectives, distinguish acquisition from retention, evaluate incrementality, and translate insights into campaign and bidding decisions. They have strong quantitative and technical fluency across attribution, experimentation, causal measurement, customer-lifecycle signals, and ads optimization. They excel at partnering cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other teams to transform complex sigånals and methodologies into credible, actionable, privacy-durable, and scalable products.
